verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta ki Jekọp, Vrẹn, yanran kpo Bẹtẹl, re wọ dia Etiyin; rere wọ dia Etiyin so agbada kẹ Ọghẹnẹ rọ vwẹ oma phia kẹ wẹ na ọke wọ vwọ djẹ nẹ obọ rẹ oniọvo wẹn Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ki jekop vren yanran kpo betel re wo dia etiyin rere wo dia etiyin so agbada ke oghene ro vwe oma phia ke we na oke wo vwo dje ne obo re oniovo wen iso

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp da ta kẹ evwruwevwi rọye kugbe ekru re vẹ ọye gba herọ, Wa kpare ẹdjọ erhorha ri rhe ovwan ejobi kufia, re we phorho oma rẹ ovwan, re we ku iwun rẹ ovwan phihọ otọ,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da ta ke evwruwevwi roye kugbe ekru re ve oye gba hero wa kpare edjo erhorha ri rhe ovwan ejobi kufia re we phorho oma re ovwan re we ku iwun re ovwan phiho oto

verses.text_urhobo: we jẹn avwanre vrẹn re e kpo Bẹtẹl, re Me dia oboyi so agbada kẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro nyo vwe vwẹ ọke rẹ ukpokpogho, rọ vẹ ovwẹ herọ vwẹ asan kasan Me rare ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: we jen avwanre vren re e kpo betel re me dia oboyi so agbada ke oghene ro nyo vwe vwe oke re ukpokpogho ro ve ovwe hero vwe asan kasan me rare ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da vwẹ ẹdjọ, erhorha rẹ ayen vwori ejobi kẹ Jekọp, kugbe isa rẹ erhọn rẹ ayen ku phihọ, Jekọp de si ayen nu vwẹ otọ rẹ ọhahe rọ kẹrẹ Shikẹm.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da vwe edjo erhorha re ayen vwori ejobi ke jekop kugbe isa re erhon re ayen ku phiho jekop de si ayen nu vwe oto re ohahe ro kere shikem

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ayen vwọ yan re, uguegue ro nẹ obọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ rhe de rhi mu irere re riariẹ ayen phihọ, oshọ gbi jẹ ayen vwọ tua emọ ri Jekọp na-a.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen vwo yan re uguegue ro ne obo re oghene rhe de rhi mu irere re riarie ayen phiho osho gbi je ayen vwo tua emo ri jekop na a

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de rhi te Luz (kọye Bẹtẹl), rọ otọ ri Kenan, te ọye te ihwo re vẹ ọye gba herọ,
verses.text_romanized: jekop de rhi te luz koye betel ro oto ri kenan te oye te ihwo re ve oye gba hero

verses.text_urhobo: ke Etiyin ọ da so agbada, o de se odẹ rẹ asan na El-Bẹtẹl, kidie Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da vwẹ oma nẹ rọ vwọ djẹ nẹ obọ rẹ oniọvo rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ke etiyin o da so agbada o de se ode re asan na el betel kidie etiyin oghene da vwe oma ne ro vwo dje ne obo re oniovo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Deborah, rẹ ọyọrọmọ ri Rebeka, de ghwu, e de sho vwọ otọ rẹ ọhahe rọ otọ ri Bẹtẹl; kọye o de se odẹ rẹ asan na Allan-bakuth.
verses.text_romanized: deborah re oyoromo ri rebeka de ghwu e de sho vwo oto re ohahe ro oto ri betel koye o de se ode re asan na allan bakuth

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da rhoma vwẹ oma phia kẹ Jekọp, ro vwo nẹ Padanaram cha, ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da rhoma vwe oma phia ke jekop ro vwo ne padanaram cha o da ne erhovwo ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ, Odẹ wẹn Jekọp, e gbi se we Jekọpu-u, ẹkẹvuọvo Izrẹl kọye e se wẹ. Etiyin e de se odẹ rọye Izrẹl.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ke ode wen jekop e gbi se we jekopu u ekevuovo izrel koye e se we etiyin e de se ode roye izrel

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba, gbe vwiẹ rere wo bu; ẹgborho buebu kugbe ẹgborho buebu ki nẹ agada wẹn rhe, ivie ki nẹ oma wẹn rhe.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ke mevwe oghene ro vwo egba gbe vwie rere wo bu egborho buebu kugbe egborho buebu ki ne agada wen rhe ivie ki ne oma wen rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ re Me vwọ kẹ Ebraham, kugbe Aizik ke Me je vwẹ ayen kẹ wẹ, ke Me vwẹ otọ na kẹ emọ wẹn re cha vwẹ obuko wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: oto re me vwo ke ebraham kugbe aizik ke me je vwe ayen ke we ke me vwe oto na ke emo wen re cha vwe obuko we

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ de yeri kpenu jovwo nẹ asan ro de nene ta ota na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene de yeri kpenu jovwo ne asan ro de nene ta ota na

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da so agbada phihọ asan rọ vọye da ta ota na, agbada rẹ oragha, ọ da je udi kuo, o ki ji ku evwri kuo.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da so agbada phiho asan ro voye da ta ota na agbada re oragha o da je udi kuo o ki ji ku evwri kuo

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Jekọp de se odẹ re asan rẹ Ọghẹnẹ da ta ota kẹ na, Bẹtẹl.
verses.text_romanized: koye jekop de se ode re asan re oghene da ta ota ke na betel

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen de mu oyan ni Bẹtẹl, rẹ ayen vwo si kerẹ Efrat re, Rachel kọ chuẹ uvwiẹ, uvwiẹ na ganre gangan.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen de mu oyan ni betel re ayen vwo si kere efrat re rachel ko chue uvwie uvwie na ganre gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Re uvwiẹ na vwọ ganre, orhere na da ta kẹ, Wọ djẹ oshọ-ọ, kidie wo che vwiẹ ọmọshare ọfa.
verses.text_romanized: re uvwie na vwo ganre orhere na da ta ke wo dje osho o kidie wo che vwie omoshare ofa

verses.text_urhobo: Ro vwo sherua re (kidie o ghwuru), o de se odẹ rọye Ben-oni; ẹkẹvuọvo ọsẹ rọye de se Bẹnjamin.
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo sherua re kidie o ghwuru o de se ode roye ben oni ekevuovo ose roye de se benjamin

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Rachel de ghwu, e de sho vwẹ idjerhe rẹ Efrat (kọye Bẹtlẹhẹm),
verses.text_romanized: etiyin rachel de ghwu e de sho vwe idjerhe re efrat koye betlehem

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ma osusu phihọ enu rẹ ushi rọye; kọye osusu rọ enu rẹ ushi ri Rachel rhi te nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ma osusu phiho enu re ushi roye koye osusu ro enu re ushi ri rachel rhi te none na

verses.text_urhobo: Izrẹl de mu oyan, o de chivwi utughẹ rọye phihọ abọ oboyi rẹ ọgua-enu ri Eder.
verses.text_romanized: izrel de mu oyan o de chivwi utughe roye phiho abo oboyi re ogua enu ri eder

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ayen vwọ otọ na re Rubẹn de nene Bilhah rẹ aye rẹ ọsẹ rọye mroma; Izrẹl de nyo. Emeshare rẹ Jekọp da dia ihwivẹ.
verses.text_romanized: re ayen vwo oto na re ruben de nene bilhah re aye re ose roye mroma izrel de nyo emeshare re jekop da dia ihwive

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Leah Rubẹn (owanra ri Jekọp), Simiọn, Livae, Juda, Isaka, kugbe Zẹbulọn.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri leah ruben owanra ri jekop simion livae juda isaka kugbe zebulon

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Rachel Josẹf kugbe Bẹnjamin.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri rachel josef kugbe benjamin

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Bilhah, ọyọrọmọ ri Rachel: Dan Kugbe Naftali.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri bilhah oyoromo ri rachel dan kugbe naftali

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Zilpah, ọyọrọmọ ri Leah, Gad kugbe Asha. Enana emọ ri Jekọp vwiẹri vwi Padanaram.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri zilpah oyoromo ri leah gad kugbe asha enana emo ri jekop vwieri vwi padanaram

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de rhi te otọ rẹ ọsẹ rọye Aizik vwi Mamre, eyẹ Kiriataba (kọye Hebrọn), asan rẹ Ebraham vẹ Aizik diare jovwo.
verses.text_romanized: jekop de rhi te oto re ose roye aizik vwi mamre eye kiriataba koye hebron asan re ebraham ve aizik diare jovwo

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ rẹ Aizik ejobi da dia ikpe ujurhiri:
verses.text_romanized: ede re akpo re aizik ejobi da dia ikpe ujurhiri

verses.text_urhobo: Aizik de phi ẹnwẹn họ, o de ghwu e de sho kugbe esẹ rọye ọ ghworo hẹrẹ hẹrẹ; emọ rọye Isọ kugbe Jekọp de sho.
verses.text_romanized: aizik de phi enwen ho o de ghwu e de sho kugbe ese roye o ghworo here here emo roye iso kugbe jekop de sho

headings.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ Bruba kẹ Jekọp vwi Bẹtẹl
headings.text_romanized: oghene bruba ke jekop vwi betel
